$comment: Jamaican Patois urgent messages. DRAFT translation derived from en.json; needs native-speaker review and clinical adviser approval. Phone numbers and hrefs are byte-identical to en.json.

emergency.title: Dis coulda be a emergency
body: Nuh wait fi see if it get betta.
Dis app cyaan check symptom or give medical advice.
emergency.banner: Yuh tell wi someting weh coulda be a emergency. If yuh nuh do it yet, call 999 now.

urgent.title: Beg yuh, get help soon
body: Wha yuh describe might need a doctor or nurse fi look pon it soon.
Contact NHS 111 now, pon di phone or online, or call yuh GP surgery if it open.
If it get worse, or yuh tink a emergency, call 999.
Dis app cyaan check symptom or give medical advice.
urgent.banner: Yuh tell wi someting weh might need help soon. If yuh nuh do it yet, contact NHS 111 or yuh GP surgery.

crisis.title: Yuh nuh haffi face dis by yuhself
body: It sound like yuh a go through someting really hard right now.
Yuh can talk to Samaritans fi free, any time, day or night. Call 116 123.
If yuh in danger right now, or yuh might act pon dem thought deh, call 999 now.
Yuh can call NHS 111 too fi urgent mental health help.
crisis.banner: Yuh tell wi yuh might a go through someting really hard. Samaritans deh deh any time pon 116 123. If yuh in danger right now, call 999.

continueCheck.link: Mi nuh in danger an mi waan go on
continueCheck.title: Before yuh go on
body: Only go on if yuh nuh in danger right now.
Samaritans deh deh any time, day or night. Call 116 123.
continueCheck.confirm: Mi nuh in danger right now
